The '''Sulloria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Svivreni sector/Legends|Svivreni sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as [[Sullorian]]s.<ref name="ScoundrelsWages" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sulloria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-19.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
